claim_text: Commit c7a28f8 changed the division to a bit shift, giving the same value, and its message gives no reason for the value.
_compat.py:340 in sqlmodel_init calls it; non-table instance uses __pydantic_validator__.validate_python, table takes else branch
context_test.go (lines 695, 706) use similar regexes for HandlerName and HandlerNames, and debug_test.go (lines 74, 86) expect '...gin.handlerNameTest (2 handlers)' in the debug output.
A git log -S pickaxe search on backend/app/core/config.py returns only 32ab6dd for both _use_psycopg_driver and "postgres://", so no earlier commit added that function or string.
The earlier 8558cf0 hit is the older URI-building code, not URL rewriting.
Line 21 uses default options, while lines 42, 46 and 56 pass \IDNA_DEFAULT and chain or use the returned URI, so a changed return type would affect them.
It is called on bases in bases (main.py:671), so a change requiring model_config would break for plain object or non-SQLModel bases that rely on the tolerant fallback
All callers use it in boolean context, so a different return type is likely fine, but raising an exception would break them
res.json, res.jsonp and res.send of text set the header and then go through send.
The repository does not state why the abort index is half of the int8 maximum; no comment, commit message or decision record gives a reason.
src/Client.php:691 calls Idn::convertUri($uri, $idnOptions) and assigns the result to $uri.
waitReadable() already retried EINTR with no limit, as precedent for unlimited retry.
dist/ is generated by Rollup per AGENTS.md and should not be edited by hand.
Every call site of createUrl is in the listed files, with none beyond these.
Taking children[0] would pick a static child, or the wrong node, instead of the wildcard.
setCharset is marked @api private.
The emailed reset link is {settings.FRONTEND_HOST}/reset-password?token={token}, pointing at the frontend page.
src/bin/bat/main.rs:289-292 in invoke_bugreport (gated by feature bugreport) calls the function and uses unwrap_or_else to fall back to "less".
$idnOptions comes from Idn::normalizeConversionOption($config['idn_conversion'] ?? null) at src/Client.php:689.
git log -S'_use_psycopg_driver' --all returns only commit 32ab6dd, so it is the first to contain the validator.
Terminal match offsets code at src/terminal.go:4266 calls item.text.ToRunes() and reads runes[p:] in a loop, read-only, safe, but broken by a signature change.
If the $options type changes, normalizeConversionOption would likely need to change with it.
Only the password was moved out of the URL, not the token, and the commit does not say why.
The function is pub and external crates using bat as a library could be affected.
get_git_diff returns Option<LineChanges>.
It returns type unchanged if either argument is falsy.
Engine.Routes() returns RouteInfo with the Handler field, so a format change would alter the Handler field that user code reads; the HandlerFunc field is separate and unaffected.
safeInt8 caps lengths at math.MaxInt8, so the handler chain is bounded at 127.
It was added in commit 1838e25d, "feat(cargo): add vendored-libgit2 feature (#3426)", dated 2025-10-08.
The unit tests in test/utils.js:41-59 pin the current behaviour of setCharset and would break if it changed.
The documentation passes MessageFormatter::DEBUG to Middleware::log at the debug level and describes it as a full dump of request, response and any error.
terminal.go:1901 itemLines already copies ToRunes output into its own text slice, so a fresh copy would make that copy redundant.
If Abort() set the index to MaxInt8 (127), a later c.index++ would overflow the int8 to -128, making the loop condition true again so handlers could run after an abort.
Commit f42b160b (#5672) deprecated res.clearCookie accepting options.maxAge and options.expires, and is the first commit mentioning clearCookie in git log -S of lib/response.js.
Windows byte-range locks are mandatory, so locking a byte far from the start lets external readers read the PID payload at byte 0 without a PermissionError.
test_reset_password calls generate_password_reset_token with email= at test_login.py:95, and imports it at line 11.
StreamHandler calls resolveProxySelection in applyProxy at StreamHandler.php:1760.
The only production caller is the HTTP adapter, which imports the helper at lib/adapters/http.js:19.
No other callers exist apart from generated frontend client files, which only reference the URL.
bat's `vendored-libgit2` Cargo feature is defined at Cargo.toml:35 as `vendored-libgit2 = ["git2/vendored-libgit2"]`, enabling the git2 crate's feature of the same name.
